description: 0.005 USDC per call via x402, no key (unpaid call returns PaymentRequired; retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Advisory spend caps that complement your wallet's enforced hard limits (Coinbase Agentic Wallet / CDP spendControls); cannot block payments. Set per-call / per-day (rolling 24h) / per-session USD limits and optional allow-lists (payTo, hosts, networks) for a payer wallet address (replaces the previous policy for that payer). Optional ownerLock secret so the agent cannot loosen the caps later. Advisory and non-custodial. Needs a key mts_ (X-API-Key header or apiKey argument). No key? call settle_trial_key (free, 50 calls/7 days). Full plan 1 USDC/30d incl. 1,000 calls via x402.

apiKey.description: Your MoneyTools Settle key mts_… (alternative to the X-API-Key header). No key: call settle_trial_key.

ownerLock.description: Owner secret (>=12 chars); once set, caps can only be loosened with it.

perCallUsd.description: Max USD per single payment, e.g. "0.10".
